# CLI Surface Evidence

<!-- Generated by go run ./tools/clisurface -write-doc. Do not edit by hand. -->

Executable SSOT: [`cli-surface.riido.json`](cli-surface.riido.json).

Evidence artifact: `cli-surface-evidence`.

Keeps the cmd/riido command surface and root-help visibility generated from a manifest and verified against black-box CLI output plus source boundaries. Internal daemon, bridge and mwsd commands remain callable with their existing arguments but are absent from root help; claude-permission-mcp also remains absent. Legacy serve, api and task groups remain public.

| `update` | public | _none_ | cmd/riido, internal/selfupdate | RIID-6021: replaces an installer-managed riido (resolved binary named riido with an adjacent VERSION equal to the running version, outside any .app bundle) with the newest CDN package of its install channel (RIID-6036): production riido in $HOME/.riido/bin follows latest and a riido-staging install (INSTALL_CHANNEL=staging marker beside the binary, written by scripts/install-riido-daemon.sh RIIDO_DAEMON_CHANNEL=staging) follows staging; latest reads releases/safe/ai-agent and staging reads releases/staging-safe/ai-agent, the same active feeds as the desktop app, never the frozen legacy latest/staging prefixes; --channel staging|latest overrides. Packages whose VERSION lacks a vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH core are rejected. Within the same channel a lower vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH is reported as newer_installed and never installed; only an explicit switch to the other channel may move to a lower version. It downloads SHA256SUMS and the platform tar.gz over HTTPS only, verifies the checksum, extracts only the installer's top-level files and the helper bundle (no links, special files, setuid or unsafe paths, bounded size), checks VERSION, riido and helper architecture, helper manifest, Info.plist and profile, and verifies the helper code signature before any change. It then swaps helper, manifest and VERSION and renames riido last within the install directory; any earlier failure leaves the current install untouched. --check reports without installing. macOS arm64/amd64 only; agent mode, Desktop-bundled CLIs and other layouts return exit 8 with the installer as the next step. It never reads credentials | `main-command-update` |

## Assertions

- root help contains only public command groups; internal command dispatch and direct daemon help remain compatible
- cli, daemon-lifecycle and mwsd-project workflow checks use direct daemon help for internal usage tokens
- cmd/riido remains local-only and must not open public TCP or HTTP listeners
- direct internal-command help must expose each declared command group; root help must expose only groups marked public
- bridge providers output must expose the provider vocabulary without launching provider tasks
- work-context commands must reject secrets passed as arguments and keep the envelope on stdout
